t: The Magnusson Interchangeable Bit Holding Screwdriver Set provides a comprehensive solution for professional screw driving tasks. This versatile screwdriver kit is ideal for electricians, plumbers, and general builders needing a compact, reliable tool on site or in the workshop. It features a quick-release universal magnetic bit holder for secure retention and fast bit swaps, alongside a wide selection of durable S2 steel bits including Phillips, Pozidriv, Hex, slotted, and Torx. The comfort grip handle ensures enhanced control, while colour-coded bits allow for easy identification. A robust plastic carry case with a belt clip keeps all components organised and readily accessible.
